text:
Jordan: Hey team — Mosaic Labs is asking for a non-standard payment setup. They want 60% annual upfront, but invoiced in three quarterly installments, with the remaining 40% on net45 spreads across year 2. Also asking for a $50k usage credit to cover POC spend. Can we get a quick decision before EOD tomorrow?

Maria: tagging @Tom and @Priya for deal/finance review. Quick summary: ARR = $1.2M, commit 2yrs, requested split to align with their fiscal quarter. They want invoices on Mar/Jun/Sep for the 60% portion.

Alex: from SE side — POC completed, performance ok. We offered $50k credit for verified usage; they'd like to apply it against first invoice. No special tech blockers.

Priya: finance questions — can we treat the 60% as "annual prepay" but invoice in installments? Need confirmation on revenue recognition and whether we can net the $50k credit at billing or as a contra-revenue.

Tom: deal desk — need to see proposed legal language for payment schedule + fallback if they miss a quarter. Also need approval band: for >$1M deals, pricing/terms exceptions require VP sales sign-off unless Finance approves deviation.

Jordan: copied below is the schedule they proposed:```
Invoice 1 (60% tranche part A): 2026-03-15 — 30% of ARR
Invoice 2 (60% tranche part B): 2026-06-15 — 15% of ARR
Invoice 3 (60% tranche part C): 2026-09-15 — 15% of ARR
Remaining: 40% invoiced in 4 equal net45 invoices across 2027 (quarterly)
Apply $50,000 usage credit to Invoice 1
```

Maria: ops-bot ran a quick policy check — flags: split-invoicing-for-prepay (manual review required), apply-credit-to-upfront (allowed w/finance signoff).

Priya: finance initial take — we can invoice split prepay but revenue recognition team will still require the full prepay to be recognized as deferred revenue and amortized. Applying the credit to invoice 1 is fine operationally, but we need a memo explaining credit trigger (POC metrics) and who certifies it.

Elena: legal — need fallbacks: if any installment misses, auto-downgrade to standard monthly billing and revoke the prepay discount; also include a clause that credit is contingent on POC acceptance checklist (Alex to provide). I can draft a short amendment.

Alex: I’ll drop the POC acceptance checklist here by EOD. It has the perf metrics and logs.

Tom: To move forward, I need: (1) formal approval from VP Sales (please @VP-Sales), (2) written sign-off from Finance (Priya), and (3) legal amendment draft (Elena). If VP-Sales signs off we can route to Contracts for execution.

Jordan: pinging @VP-Sales — can you review and give greenlight or escalate? Customer needs this to close by Friday.

VP-Sales: reviewed quickly — okay to approve as long as Finance and Legal finalize wording and we keep standard penalty for missed installments. Approve in principle. :thumbsup:

Priya: Finance sign-off provided — we approve the split-invoice schedule and applying $50k credit to Invoice 1. Condition: credit must be documented and certified by Sales Eng (Alex) and Finance will require a one-page memo attached to the order.

Elena: I’ll prepare a 2-paragraph amendment and include the fallback and credit conditions. Draft ready in ~3 hours.

Maria: thanks all. Next steps: Jordan to confirm customer accepts amendment language, Alex to upload POC checklist, Elena to attach amendment, Priya to add memo, Tom to route to Contracts after VP sign-off (done). Jordan — want me to create the order change request in SFDC?

Jordan: please do — create with notes: "60% annual prepay invoiced in 3 installments; $50k usage credit applied to invoice 1; 40% remaining on net45 quarterly in year 2; contingent on signed amendment and POC certification."

ops-bot: Order change created: OC-2026-0897. Assigned to Contracts.

Maria: marking this resolved for deal desk — reopen if any blocker. :white_check_mark:
